Val has worked since 2015:
Software Engineer, self-employed (Aug 2026 - present): building production web and iOS apps and shipping MVPs within months.
Lead Mobile Application Developer, Yoonet (Nov 2020 - Aug 2026): architected native iOS apps in Swift with REST, GraphQL, Firebase and Mapbox, with 85%+ test coverage.
Mid iOS Developer, Pixsell Creatives (Jul - Oct 2020).
Web/iOS Developer, Thirty One Digital (Jul 2016 - Jul 2020).

faqs.q: What is Val working on now?
faqs.a: Since August 2026 Val has been working independently as a Software Engineer, building production-grade web and iOS apps from architecture through deployment and shipping MVPs within months, using AI-assisted tools across planning, UI, testing and deployment.
Bachelor of Science in Information Technology from Informatics College - Eastwood (April 2015). Val was an Academic Excellence Awardee.
